q: Which detail most changes an agentic benchmark score besides the model?
options: The harness, budget and number of attempts
explain: Always ask which harness, what budget and what date.

q: Two models score 94.1% and 94.8% on a saturated benchmark of a few hundred items. What can you conclude?
options: Probably nothing: the gap is within noise near the ceiling

q: Why do dynamic benchmarks such as new competition problems matter?
options: They resist contamination from training data

q: What must match before comparing two benchmark scores?
options: Harness, prompts, attempts, tools, budget and grader
